description:
Get all provisioningObjectSummary events that occurred in your tenant, such as the deletion of a group in a target application or the creation of a user when provisioning user accounts from your HR system. 

TIP: Lists provisioning logs for Azure AD and third-party integrations. Use $filter=statusInfo/status eq 'failure' to find failed provisioning events. Use $filter=provisioningAction eq 'create' to filter by action type (create, update, delete, disable). Each entry has sourceSystem, targetSystem, provisioningAction, initiatedBy, sourceIdentity, targetIdentity, and statusInfo.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-provisioning-logs
